description: Verify that TCP in CLOSED sends a RST with seq=0 in response to an incoming non-RST/ACK segment (RFC 793 §3.9 p65 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
When a segment arrives at a port that has no live socket, RFC 793 §3.9 says the receiver replies with a RST. If the incoming segment did not carry an ACK, the RST's seq is 0 (no ACK to use as seed).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in CLOSED state.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN (no ACK), then FIN (no ACK), then DATA (no ACK).
3. Observation: For each, DUT → Tester: RST with seq == 0   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT emits RST with seq=0 to each non-ACK probe.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_seq_<probe> — RST seq is not 0
• Fail_timeout_<probe> — no DUT RST after the probe

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted RST seq=0 to every non-ACK probe — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_seq_syn: DUT RST seq not zero after SYN
verdicts.Fail_wrong_seq_fin: DUT RST seq not zero after FIN
verdicts.Fail_wrong_seq_data: DUT RST seq not zero after data
